title: What is the EAPCET counselling code of QISCET?
summary: Example AEO post. It stays a draft until a staff member publishes it.

blocks.text: 70% of seats (Category A) are filled by the Government of Andhra Pradesh through AP EAPCET counselling. 30% (Category B) are filled by the college as per government norms. Diploma holders join the second year through AP ECET.
How to ask the admissions office
Call the admissions helpline or the college office, or write to the principal. Office hours are Monday to Saturday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM. Do not rely on unofficial numbers circulating on social media.

seo.llmSummary: The AP EAPCET and ECET counselling code for QIS College of Engineering & Technology (QISCET), Ongole, is QISE. For 2026-27 admissions, call +91 92464 19530 or +91 92464 19542, or email principal@qiscet.edu.in. Category A seats are filled by the state through EAPCET; Category B seats are filled by the college.
